problem_statement: Queue runs crash with `KeyError: 'info'` whenever a proposed assignment targets a ward that has beds pending cleaning. Since the census feed started flagging cleaning wards, the assignment guard emits info-level reports for those placements, and the report routing step blows up on them, so every later assignment in the batch is never applied. Info reports should simply be logged and the batch should carry on. Reproduce with `python -m pytest -q tests` (see `tests/test_queue.py::test_cleaning_ward_assignment_is_applied`).
